Highlights
Discover Atacama's gems: Red Stones, Lagoons, Chaxa.
Witness the surreal beauty of Red Stones and flamingos.
Experience the magic of Atacama with expert guidance.
Engage with the desert's history and ecology.
Indulge in culinary delights amidst breathtaking vistas.
Full description
Embark on a captivating 3-in-1 excursion, delving into the heart of the Atacama Desert's cultural and natural treasures.

During this experience, you'll enjoy an open-air breakfast, the perfect start to a day filled with wonder and unforgettable landscapes. The tour includes a visit to the impressive Red Rock formations, sculpted over centuries by the elements, whose crimson hues create a unique scene in the middle of the high plateau.

The experience also includes a visit to the high-altitude village of Socaire, where you can learn about the local culture, its history, and the traditional adobe architecture that characterizes this area of the desert. Along the way, you'll explore the high-altitude lagoons of Miscanti and Miñiques, surrounded by volcanoes and breathtaking landscapes, whose intensely colored waters offer an atmosphere of calm and connection with nature. The itinerary also includes a visit to Laguna Chaxa, located in the Atacama Salt Flat, where the saline surface It contrasts with the desert environment, and at certain times of the year, it's possible to observe wildlife characteristic of the area within the Los Flamencos National Reserve.

During the day, lunch is included in a natural setting, allowing you to enjoy a peaceful break before continuing to explore the landscapes of the high plateau.

Throughout the day, our bilingual guides will share information about the history, culture, and ecology of the desert, enriching the experience and providing a deeper understanding of this extraordinary natural environment.
